title: Libre3 Webfollower: beonlabs community script for Web Follower is not available
symptom: The Libre3 Webfollower stopped getting data at some point. A fresh installation of xDrip didn't help. The source of the custom script returns a file with text 'service ceased', so xDrip doesn't get data from Libre 3 anymore.
evidence_quote: the source of the custom script https://community-script.beonlabs.net returns a file with text "service ceased". So that xDrip doesn't get data from Libre 3 anymore.
